name: The majority voted against a motion introduced by NSW Senator [David Shoebridge](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/nsw/david_shoebridge) (Greens): > *That so much of sessional and standing orders be suspended as would prevent me from making a short contribution.* Sessional and standing orders are the usual procedural rules of parliament.
